name: retrograde_mercury

Planetary longitudes are not independently confirmed here — they rest on test_invariants.py and the hand-cast graha sphuta table in test_textbook.py. Re-frozen unchanged at engine 0.6.1: the Moon epicycle correction is inside Surya Siddhanta and this fixture is drik, so every value here is byte-identical to 0.6.0 and only the version stamp moved.
why: Mercury retrograde 21 Apr - 14 May 2023. Exercises the retro flag and Mercury's 12-deg retro combustion orb.
